bootstrap_inference.two_sided_95_interval_role: reported for effect-size context; not the gate decision rule

confirmatory_population.primary_paired_analysis_rule: Use exactly the same target-free actionable parent IDs for AutoGrey and the relevant comparator. Actionability, forecast availability, structural refusals, and technical refusals must be frozen before numeric REALBENCH3 target parsing. No parent may be removed from only one side after targets open.
confirmatory_population.refusal_rule: Preserve every frozen structural/technical refusal identity and count. Do not replace refused, short, difficult, failed, or inconvenient reserved parents after target opening.
confirmatory_population.reservation: the immutable REALBENCH3 reservation created before v2 outcome-driven development

effect_definitions.gate_A_mean_selection_difference: mean(AutoGrey eligible regret - GLOBAL eligible regret)
effect_definitions.gate_C1_tail_selection_difference: CVaR90(AutoGrey eligible regret) - CVaR90(GLOBAL eligible regret)

failure_and_partial_success_interpretati.Gate_A_B_pass_Gate_C_fail: Gate A and Gate B claims may stand. Overall robust confirmation fails.
failure_and_partial_success_interpretati.Gate_A_fail: Overall confirmatory sequence stops. Gate B/C outcomes are reportable only as descriptive/nonconfirmatory; no external selector-value confirmation claim.
failure_and_partial_success_interpretati.Gate_A_pass_Gate_B_fail: Gate A claim may stand. Overall confirmation fails. Gate C is descriptive/nonconfirmatory.
failure_and_partial_success_interpretati.negative_result_policy: Preserve and publish/report the result; no post-REALBENCH3 retuning or margin change.

fixed_sequence_gatekeeping.multiplicity_reason: The ordered fixed-sequence procedure controls the confirmatory familywise error rate without splitting alpha across A/B/C. Gate C is an intersection-union requirement: both C1 and C2 must pass, so no alpha split is used between its two necessary components.
fixed_sequence_gatekeeping.rule: Gate A is tested first at alpha=0.05. Gate B is confirmatory only if Gate A passes. Gate C is confirmatory only if Gates A and B pass. Later-gate statistics may always be reported, but if an earlier gate fails they are descriptive/nonconfirmatory.

Gate_A.claim_if_pass: On REALBENCH3, AutoGrey has lower mean eligible grey-family selection regret than the frozen GLOBAL comparator.
Gate_A.estimand: mean eligible regret difference AutoGrey minus GLOBAL
Gate_A.name: selector_value

Gate_B.claim_if_pass: On REALBENCH3, AutoGrey is noninferior to NG10 in mean MASE within the prespecified 0.05-MASE margin.
Gate_B.estimand: mean MASE difference AutoGrey minus NG10
forbidden_interpretation: superior to NG10 solely because noninferiority passes
Gate_B.name: practical_mean_noninferiority

C1.estimand: CVaR90 eligible regret difference AutoGrey minus GLOBAL

C2.estimand: CVaR90 MASE difference AutoGrey minus NG10

Gate_C.claim_if_pass: The prespecified tail-robustness requirement is satisfied for both grey-family selection regret and practical MASE.
Gate_C.name: joint_tail_robustness
Gate_C.pass_rule: both C1 and C2 must pass

immutability_after_p10a.implementation_only_repairs_allowed: Only target-independent implementation/path/runtime repairs that preserve every scientific field in this lock. Failed attempts must be preserved. If repair is needed after REALBENCH3 opening, target access remains OPEN and the repair cannot use target outcomes to alter any scientific choice.

immutable_scientific_objects.practical_loss: MASE of deployed forecast using full-D frozen scale and no epsilon
immutable_scientific_objects.selection_loss: eligible regret relative to same-parent best selectable grey action
immutable_scientific_objects.tail_estimand: CVaR90 = mean of worst ceil(0.10*N) parent-level losses/regrets

applies_to: Gate B mean practical MASE difference
Gate C2 CVaR90 practical MASE difference
noninferiority_margin.rationale: A single fixed 0.05-MASE tolerance is used for both practical mean and tail criteria. It is intentionally small on the MASE scale and avoids choosing separate post-development margins. It is not an equivalence margin and does not permit a superiority claim against NG10.

overall_confirmatory_success.definition: Gate_A PASS AND Gate_B PASS AND Gate_C PASS
forbidden_claims_even_if_full_success: AutoGrey is universally the best forecasting method
AutoGrey is superior to every non-grey method
results generalize beyond the reserved REALBENCH3 population without qualification
overall_confirmatory_success.full_success_claim: Under the frozen REALBENCH3 protocol, AutoGrey demonstrates external selector-value superiority over GLOBAL together with practical mean noninferiority to NG10 within 0.05 MASE and the prespecified joint tail-robustness criteria.

p10_exit_rule.P10B: build and verify the executable pretarget scoring/opening contract against frozen P1-P9 provenance without accessing REALBENCH3 numeric targets

p11_chronology.P11A_target_free_freeze: Using REALBENCH3 development prefixes only, produce and hash the target-free actionability ledger, AutoGrey decisions, GLOBAL decisions, grey action forecasts, NG10 forecasts/statuses, subgroup ledger, and refusal ledger. Numeric REALBENCH3 target suffix values remain unopened.
p11_chronology.P11B_irreversible_opening: Only after P11A passes all identity/runtime/provenance gates may the harness print an irreversible opening marker and parse numeric REALBENCH3 target suffix values exactly once.
p11_chronology.P11C_scoring: Score only the P11A-frozen decisions/forecasts under this P10 lock. No fitting, retuning, comparator switching, margin change, subgroup change, parent replacement, or cleaning-policy change.
p11_chronology.after_opening: REALBENCH3 is permanently OPEN regardless of later harness success/failure

purpose: Freeze the complete confirmatory REALBENCH3 hypothesis hierarchy, alpha, margins, bootstrap inference, populations, multiplicity, and allowable claim wording before any REALBENCH3 numeric target suffix is opened.

secondary_subgroup_policy.multiplicity: Holm-Bonferroni step-down at FWER 0.05 separately within four frozen families: selection mean regret, selection CVaR90 regret, practical mean MASE, practical CVaR90 MASE.
secondary_subgroup_policy.n_below_30: descriptive point estimates and N only; no inferential claim
secondary_subgroup_policy.status: secondary; cannot rescue or redefine the overall confirmatory result
